name: Bakery
summary: Knead wheat into dough and bake bread. Take it out too early and it's raw, too late and it burns.

blocks.text: The Wheat Fields grow wheat; the baker turns it into bread, which the Market, the Cottages and the Guild Hall need. You write the baker's script, and it runs one shift after every delve.
knead() turns 2 wheat into 1 dough. light() burns 1 wood and keeps the oven fire going 12 ticks longer. bake() puts up to 4 dough in the oven. take_out() takes the loaves out again.

blocks.tip: Bread only bakes while the fire burns. It's done after 4 to 7 ticks in the oven: take it out earlier and it goes back to the dough pile, later and it burns.

blocks.text: baked() tells you how many ticks the loaves have been baking (or -1 if the oven is empty), and fire() how long the fire keeps burning. With loops you can bake batch after batch:
wheat(), dough(), bread(), fire(), tray() and baked() tell you what's in the bakery right now.

blocks.tip: A shift lasts 12 seconds (120 ticks). Dough that's left over is lost at the end of the shift, but unused wheat stays in your stores.
